data.long_meaning: Derived from Old German 'hun' (hunter) and 'fred' (power, strength). This name signifies a strong and powerful hunter. The name Hunfredo carries the meaning “Hunter's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hunfredo usually hope their child will grow to embody hunter's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
